race.comment: INDEFINITE (10) has the right platform to rebound after finishing fourth in a CL4 over 1450m at Cairns, beaten 1.5L after racing prominently. The return to 1200m, 2.5kg weight relief strengthens his case, and his earlier Open fifth at Atherton gives the form enough depth for this. CIFONELLI (1) is the obvious danger after winning a BM70 at this track over 1000m as favourite, and his two wins from three starts at this track and distance make the extra ground no concern. KEEP SAFE (12) was thereabouts when resuming at Ipswich and should improve with that run under his belt. Keeping safe. KICKOFF (15) will be rock-hard fit now following a nice effort at this track last start when third.
